title: Executive Assistant

description:

title: Quotations & Estimating Coordinator
description:
Are you an experienced Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Costing Coordinator or Commercial Coordinator looking for your next opportunity within a manufacturing business in the Hull area?

Do you enjoy working with detailed information, building accurate quotations and making sure every element of a customer requirement has been properly costed?

If so, this Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job in Hull could be a really good next step.

Our client is an established manufacturing business with a strong reputation for producing bespoke solutions for its customers. Due to a recent change within the team, they are now looking for a Quotations & Estimating Coordinator to join their Commercial department.

You ll be working closely with Account Management, Commercial and operational teams, turning customer requirements into accurate, competitive quotations. It s a role that needs someone who enjoys detail, understands how costs come together and can manage a busy workload without losing accuracy.

What the Quotations & Estimating Coordinator job involves

You ll be responsible for producing accurate and timely customer quotations, taking into account all of the different elements required to deliver each project.
- Producing accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Reviewing customer briefs and information supplied by the Account Management team.
- Calculating costs across areas such as materials, design work, labour, production time and other associated costs.
- Creating bespoke quotations based on individual customer requirements.
- Prioritising estimates according to customer needs and commercial deadlines.
- Supporting Account Management and Business Development with quotations for both new and existing customers.
- Liaising with suppliers, customers and colleagues across the wider business where further information is required.
- Maintaining accurate information within the company s CRM and estimating systems.
- Helping to ensure consistency across pricing and estimating processes.

The role plays an important part in supporting both existing customers and new business opportunities.

Skills required

We re looking for someone who is naturally organised, enjoys working with numbers and detailed information, and takes real pride in accuracy.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience within estimating, quotations, costing, pricing, commercial coordination or a similar role.
- Experience within manufacturing, print, packaging, engineering or another production environment would be advantageous.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence working with detailed cost information.
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong data processing and analytical skills.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills and confidence liaising with customers, suppliers and internal departments.
- A structured and process-driven approach.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- Experience using CRM or estimating software would be beneficial.
- A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across the team.

We are particularly looking for someone who is accurate, adaptable, able to work under pressure and comfortable managing changing priorities.

You may currently be working as a Quotations Coordinator, Estimator, Cost Estimator, Manufacturing Estimator, Commercial Coordinator, Pricing Coordinator, Costing Coordinator, Sales Estimator or Commercial Estimator and be looking for your next opportunity in the Hull area.

Other information
- Hours: 9.00am 5.30pm
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays, with the opportunity to buy up to five additional days.
- Auto-enrolment pension.
- Regular company events and social activities throughout the year.
- Free on-site parking.
- Christmas Eve and New Year s Eve early finish, subject to business requirements.
- Opportunity to join an established manufacturing business with a strong emphasis on integrity, teamwork and sustainability.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

title: HR Co-ordinator
description:
Role: HR Co-ordinator (People and Culture)

Sector: Public Sector

Duration: 12 months FTC

Location: Hull

Salary: up to £34,434 per annum (DOE)

Sellick Partnership is currently recruiting for an experienced HR Co-ordinator to join our client based in Hull, working on a hybrid basis for a 12 month fixed term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a HR professional looking for a varied role covering all aspects of human resources within a fast-paced and people-focused environment.

The HR Co-ordinator will work closely with managers and employees across the organisation, providing comprehensive HR support throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring HR processes are delivered efficiently, professionally and in line with

Key responsibilities for theHR Co-ordinator will include;
- Supporting the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment through to leaving
- Supporting recruitment campaigns, interviews, onboarding and pre-employment checks
- Providing first-line HR advice and guidance to managers and employees
- Managing HR administration including contracts, variations, employment documentation and record keeping
- Supporting employee relations cases including absence management, disciplinaries, grievances and performance management
- Assisting with workforce planning and organisational change activity
- Maintaining HR systems and ensuring employee data is accurate and compliant
- Supporting learning and development initiatives and training administration
- Producing HR reports and workforce data to support decision making
- Monitoring compliance with employment legislation, policies and procedures
- Contributing to HR projects and continuous improvement activities
- Supporting wellbeing, engagement and inclusion initiatives across the organisation

The Ideal candidate for the HR Co-ordinator will;
- Previous experience within a HR generalist role covering a broad range of HR activities
- Knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple properties
- Experience of supporting in employee relations matters

The HR Co-ordinator will need to have excellent communication skills and effectively be able to communicate to stakeholders of all levels. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have an impeccable eye for detail and accuracy to ensure all workload is carried out effectively and efficiently. They will also need to able to prioritise their workload and be efficient and effective to meet unpredictable deadlines and deal with conflicting demands, whilst working in a high-pressured environment.

Our client is hoping to have the HR Co-ordinator in the role as soon as possible, therefore if you believe your experience meets the criteria above, please contact Charlotte Broomfield or Tim Farnsworth by Friday 4 September by 10am by submitting your CV directly.

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

title: Team Administration Assistant
description:
Team Administration Assistant

Company & Location: Yorkshire Accountancy, 123 Hallgate, Cottingham, HU16 4 DA
Hours: 15-20 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Salary: 13.00 per hour
Contract: Permanent, part-time
Working arrangement: Office based

About the role

We are looking for an organised, proactive and personable Team Administration Assistant to provide practical administrative support across our practice.

This is a varied administration role supporting our accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams. The purpose of the position is to take ownership of the important day-to-day administrative tasks that keep client work moving, records up to date and our teams organised.

This is not an accountancy or tax position and we are not looking for someone with an accounting background. We are looking for someone who enjoys administration, is organised, gets things done and is happy helping different members of a busy team.

Key responsibilities

The role will include:

Accounts and client administration

Logging new accounts jobs and other work onto our systems.

Keeping job records and internal systems up to date.

Chasing clients for accounting records and other information.

Chasing signed accounts and Companies House documents, including confirmation statements.

Assisting with monthly accounts and bookkeeping job updates.

Maintaining and organising electronic client records and folders.

Processing changes to client details.

Sending clients copies of documents and information when requested.

Tax and MTD administration

Assisting with administrative data entry relating to Making Tax Digital.

Logging Self Assessment checklists and information returned by clients.

Scanning and saving tax working papers and client documents.

Sending copies of SA302s, previous tax returns and other documents requested by clients.

Providing general administrative support to the tax team, particularly during busy periods.

Practice and team administration

Assisting with monthly reviews of client fixed fees.

Assisting with quarterly reviews of bookkeeping and payroll fixed fees.

Sorting, scanning and processing incoming post.

Maintaining electronic post folders and filing.

Scanning, saving and organising client documents.

Providing administrative cover when other members of the team are absent.

Helping the accounts, tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams with routine administrative tasks.

Taking ownership of agreed recurring administrative tasks and making sure they are completed on time.

Credit control

Assisting with routine credit control.

Monitoring outstanding client balances.

Sending agreed payment reminders.

Following up outstanding amounts where required.

Keeping credit control records up to date.

About you

Previous office or administrative experience would be useful, but it is not essential. We are more interested in finding someone with the right attitude and approach.

We are looking for someone who is:
- organised and able to manage a number of different tasks;
- proactive and willing to find the next job rather than always waiting to be asked;
- reliable and conscientious;
- friendly, approachable and confident speaking to people;
- comfortable communicating with clients by telephone and email;
- accurate and attentive to detail;
- comfortable using computers and learning different systems;
- willing to ask questions when unsure;
- able to handle confidential information appropriately;
- happy working as part of a team; and
- willing to help different areas of the practice when required.

What we're looking for

The right person will enjoy being the person who keeps things organised and makes sure things get done.

There will be a mixture of regular responsibilities and ad-hoc tasks, so we're looking for somebody who can spot what needs doing, take ownership of it and see it through.

Although you will work closely with our accountants and tax, bookkeeping and payroll teams, this is an administration role rather than a training position for an accountancy or tax career.

We want someone who is happy to build their knowledge of how our practice operates and become a reliable source of administrative support across the business.

title: Material Planner/Administrator
description:
Material Planner

Location: Goole

Duration: 6 Months

Pay Rate: 16.36 per hour PAYE

Hours per week:

40 hours per week

Flexible hours (8am-4pm or 9am-5pm)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and proactive Material Planner to join a dynamic supply chain and operations team. This is a pivotal role responsible for driving material demand planning, forecasting accuracy, and inventory optimisation across multiple projects and operational programmes.

Working closely with stakeholders across operations, commercial, project management, procurement, and supply chain functions, you will ensure materials are forecasted, planned, and scheduled effectively to support business requirements while maintaining optimal inventory levels. You will play a key role in improving forecasting methodologies, enhancing planning processes, and supporting the transition towards greater automation and efficiency within the planning function.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex planning challenges, and influencing operational performance through effective material management.

Key Responsibilities
Material Forecasting & Demand Planning
- Develop, maintain and continuously improve material demand planning and forecasting processes.
- Analyse demand signals and business requirements to create accurate and supportable material forecasts.
- Work cross-functionally to understand inventory management systems and processes across the business.
- Ensure forecasting methodologies and planning systems are effectively utilised to deliver high levels of forecast accuracy.
- Support the ongoing development and optimisation of planning tools and processes.

Materials Planning & Scheduling
- Plan and schedule material requirements to support operational activities and project delivery programmes.
- Coordinate with operational teams, project managers, overhaul managers, and materials control functions to ensure material availability aligns with business needs.
- Identify potential supply risks, escalate issues appropriately, and recommend mitigation actions.
- Validate and maintain material delivery plans and associated purchase requirements.
- Conduct root cause analysis on material shortages or planning issues and support effective resolution.

Integrated Material Planning
- Support the coordination of material planning activities across the wider supply chain and operational value chain.
- Collaborate with planning, operations, inventory management, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment of forecasts and material requirements.
- Contribute to integrated business planning (IBP) and sales, inventory and operations planning (SIOP) activities.

Reporting & Performance Management
- Monitor and produce key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure planning effectiveness and forecasting accuracy.
- Develop and maintain reports that support planning decisions and provide visibility to stakeholders.
- Communicate planning insights and recommendations clearly to all levels of the organisation.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy, planning processes, and inventory performance.
- Support the implementation of best practices, planning methodologies, and system enhancements.
- Work with internal and external stakeholders to maximise the effectiveness of ERP and planning systems.
- Provide recommendations to leadership that drive operational efficiency and business performance.

Health, Safety & Compliance
- Adhere to all company health, safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Promote a strong safety culture through personal accountability and active participation in safety initiatives.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant policies, procedures, and business conduct requirements.

Key Stakeholder Relationships

You will work closely with:
- Operations Leadership Teams
- Commercial Teams
- Project Managers
- Supply Chain & Procurement Teams
- Inventory Management Teams
- Planning & Forecasting Functions
- Senior Business Stakeholders

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Strong analytical, data interpretation, and problem-solving skills.
- Proven experience in material planning, demand planning, forecasting, or supply chain planning environments.
- Experience supporting or leading IBP and/or SIOP processes.
- Knowledge of inventory management principles and best practices.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to confidently present information and recommendations at all levels of an organisation.
- Strong numeracy and data analysis capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
- Commercial awareness and understanding of supply chain performance drivers.
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Commitment to health, safety, and compliance standards.

Desirable
- Experience with ERP, forecasting, and planning systems.
- Advanced data analysis and reporting skills.
- Knowledge of inventory optimisation techniques and service level management.
- Experience working within complex operational or engineering environments.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented planner with a passion for data, forecasting, and continuous improvement. You will be comfortable working across multiple stakeholders, managing competing priorities, and using analytical insight to influence decision-making. If you thrive in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoy driving efficiencies through effective planning, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to play a key role in shaping material planning performance and supporting the successful delivery of critical operational programmes.

All PPE provided by the client and Health and Safety explained before and on site.

description: Band 2 Administrator Castle Hill Hospital, Hull Full Time Position Available Have you ever thought about working for the NHS? Behind every appointment, every clinic, every patient seen - there is someone who made it happen. Our Administrators are the unseen heroes of patient care. The reassuring voice on the phone. The organised mind behind the clinic list. The calm presence supporting patients in what can often be their most worrying moments. Without them, patients don't get seen. Services don't run. Care doesn't flow. We are recruiting Administrators to join our teams across Hull Royal Infirmary and Castle Hill Hospital. You don't need previous NHS experience - we can teach you the systems. What we can't teach is compassion, professionalism and the ability to care about getting things right for patients. That's what we're looking for. What you'll bring: A caring and compassionate approach Confidence communicating with patients and the public Good organisational skills and attention to detail Basic IT skills (typing, email, data entry, use of computer systems) The ability to work as part of a close-knit team Calmness in a sometimes fast-paced environment What you'll gain: The chance to make a real difference every single day Full and part-time opportunities with flexible working options One of the best pension schemes available Generous annual leave entitlement - because you work hard and deserve proper time off Structured training and ongoing support Genuine career progression - many of our senior leaders began in administrative roles Patient care is at the heart of everything we do, and our administrative teams are central to making that care possible. If you are organised, compassionate, and want a role where your work truly matters, we would love to hear from you. For further details with regard to this vacancy opportunity, please see the attached Job Description and Person Specification. We reserve the right to close the advert early in the event of high levels of interest. Therefore, early applications are encouraged. Please note that, in line with UKVI regulations, this vacancy does not meet the eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker Visa route. As a result, we are unable to issue a Certificate of Sponsorship for this position. We remain committed to fair and equal recruitment practices and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to employ a part time Receptionist to join our friendly team. The successful candidate will be required to provide effective and efficient reception and administrative services for the practice in a professional and courteous manner. Experienced in delivering a high standard of customer service is valued but full training for this role will be provided. The role is for 16 hours per week to cover maternity leave for 12 months . Also there is a need to be able to cover colleagues for sickness and holiday absence. Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the practice, including the provision clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies Ensure efficient running of appointment system. Be aware of flow of patients into consulting rooms and advise patients regarding any potential delays. Help coordinate urgent on the day appointments for patients either by assisting with the online forms or walk-in emergencies. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and other visitors. Participate in Care Navigation, which involves signposting patient to more appropriate health care services. Take and process new patient registrations. Safely take samples from patients as per the Sample Handing protocol. Take subject access requests from patients. Set up online user accounts. Ensure that you are familiar with the appointment systems being used for the practice and Primary Care Network appointments. Book appointments for long term condition recalls as per the patients needs. Process patient information such as notifications of deaths as per practice protocols. Receive and transfer telephone calls. Ensure accurate messages are transcribed to the relevant recipient. To assist with the Practices clerical work as required. This may involve clinical data entry onto the computer, scanning of documents, issuing mail-merge letters, recording and extracting data for audit purposes. To retrieve and advise patients of their tests results. To provide holiday and sickness cover for colleagues as required. This list is not exhaustive and other duties relative to the role may apply.

title: Finance Administrator
location: Hedon, HU12 8JE, HULL, HU12 8JD, Patrington, HU12 0PH, HULL, HU12 0LF, WITHERNSEA, HU19 2PZ, HULL, HU12 9RA, HULL, HU9 5NX
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and detail oriented Finance Administrator to join our busy Finance Team on a fixed-term basis to provide maternity cover. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator with finance experience to contribute to the efficient completion of the practice's financial processes in a supportive and collaborative environment. The role will work closely alongside our existing experienced finance team and the Head of Finance & Information in ensuring the thorough and accurate recording and reconciliation of the practice's finances. Hours per week: 30 - 37.5 Contract Duration: 12 months (Maternity cover) Working Pattern: Flexible but must work Monday Interviews will be held on: 29th October 2026 Has previous experience in a finance, bookkeeping or accounting role Possesses excellent organisational skills and keen attention to detail Is confident using Xero, Microsoft Excel, Sage 50 Payroll and other Microsoft Office applications Has strong numerical and data entry skills Can manage competing priorities and meet deadlines Demonstrates professionalism, integrity and confidentiality Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills Experience of NHS finance systems or primary care settings would be advantageous but is not essential Duties and Responsibilites The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by the Finance Administrator may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Management Team. All duties are to be carried out professionally. Monthly bank reconciliation using Xero Accounting software Invoice production Purchase ledger control Accurate recording of VAT giving consideration to the complex nature of GP VAT rules Support the Finance, Payroll and Pension Administrator with payroll calculations and payments Petty cash management Supporting our Data Quality Administrator with monthly drug invoice inspection and entry Creation and reconciliation of bank payment batches using Lloyds Commercial Banking Credit card reconciliation Practice procurement Liaise with practice accountants Maintain various finance reconciliation spreadsheets Highlight missing or inaccurate financial claims Support the Head of Finance with Enhanced Services searches and claims Income monitoring including reconciling monthly GMS statements and NHS income Monitoring the Finance email inbox and highlighting/forwarding incoming emails appropriately to Finance, Payroll and Pension Administrator or Head of Finance Other general administrative duties Confidentiality In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & Safety The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards Actively reporting of health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality, diversity and inclusion The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Responsible for undertaking own mandatory training as per practice policy Quality The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either or when supervised Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members
